purpose: Engineering activation gate for the integrated G11-G13 candidate; not benchmark-benefit or causal evidence.

execution_controls.database_and_evaluator: same DataAgentBench database boundary, registry, strict evaluator, and analyzer family as frozen G13

no_go_if: Any privacy, protocol, invariant, scoring, timeout, forced-action, or carrier-integrity violation occurs.
Valid authored state appears in fewer than four tasks.
Fewer than two tasks deliver a view with a later measurable action.
Any sufficient-budget later action is structurally contradictory.
The prior strict-pass guardrail regresses or no prior non-pass task becomes strict pass.
Authentication, quota, provider, schema, database, or benchmark infrastructure fails; do not retry automatically.
launch_preconditions: Create and hash an isolated candidate source snapshot without changing the independently reviewed files.
Use a reviewed batch launch path that invokes experiments/run_dab_tool_agent_g011_g013_integrated.py or equivalently passes --enable-g011-g013-integrated with one model attempt and zero SDK retries.
Run a provider-free prepare-only verification for all six operational batch rows.
Verify exact registry, upstream benchmark, evaluator, Python, provider route, database, disk, and idle-process bindings before any launch claim.
Create one atomic unique launch claim bound to this protocol and both task manifests.

known_execution_gap.finding: The generic multi-query runner currently invokes experiments/run_dab_tool_agent.py directly and has no integrated-mode pass-through flag. The frozen protocol therefore requires a separately reviewed isolated batch launch path before execution.
known_execution_gap.reason: This is a future panel-launch integration requirement; no reviewed candidate source is changed by this freeze.

stop_conditions: Stop before launch if any bound hash changes or the isolated batch launch path is not independently reviewed.
Stop on the first authentication, quota, provider, schema, database, privacy, protocol, or invariant failure; do not retry.
Stop after the six-task panel and require an independent result review before considering any 56-task run.
